responsibility: Implements interprocedural constant propagation and specialization (IPA-CP). This file runs the propagation and decision phases over jump-function summaries, tracks constants, propagated bits, value ranges, and polymorphic-type information, estimates profitability, decides when to create specialized clones, and records transformation summaries later consumed during clone materialization and function transformation. It is the main driver and policy engine of GCC’s IPA constant/value specialization pass.
